parameters.description:
`dot-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `dot` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Dot URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay a message through your own Dot device by posting a native Dot payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Bearer access token

device_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's DOT_DEVICE_ID value (same format as DOT_DEVICE_ID)
